coverage_notes:
SOURCES USED (4):
(A) Archived seminoles.com official football roster page, snapshot 2013-09-28: https://web.archive.org/web/20130928125459/http://www.seminoles.com/sports/m-footbl/mtt/fsu-m-footbl-mtt.html — clean HTML "Coaches" block, 15 people. Best-quality source; quotes verified by stripping tags (name and title are adjacent inline nodes, so they concatenate to "Name - Role").
(B) Wikipedia 2013 team-season page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2013_Florida_State_Seminoles_football_team — infobox/Coaching staff table (11 on-field + S&C) plus an untitled "Support Staff" bullet list.
(C) 2013 FSU Media Guide, Internet Archive OCR text: https://archive.org/download/florida-state-football-2013-media-guide/Florida%20State%20Football%2C%202013%20Media%20Guide_djvu.txt — the deepest source; yields the Support Staff / Football Office grid, the 2013 Graduate Assistants page, the Football Strength & Conditioning + Nutrition staff, and the Sports Medicine staff.
(D) 2013 BCS Bowl (championship game) Media Guide, Internet Archive OCR text: https://archive.org/download/florida-state-football-2013-bcs-bowl-media-guide/Florida%20State%20Football%2C%202013%20BCS%20Bowl%20Media%20Guide_djvu.txt — January 2014 staff/administration page; this is the source that reflects who was actually there at the title game.

OCR CAVEAT (important for quote matching): sources C and D are OCR of print media guides. Every quote I supply from them is copied byte-for-byte out of the fetched _djvu.txt, including OCR garbling (e.g. "§Rhonne Sanderson", "KevinGadowry", "feams", "ap steel", "Foothall"), so string matching against that URL should succeed — but the quotes are NOT clean English, by design. The media-guide staff pages are photo grids: OCR emits a row of names as one line and the row of captions as the next line(s). I assigned each role by matching column position across those lines. Where that mapping is ambiguous I say so in the person's note rather than guessing silently.

WHAT I COULD NOT DOCUMENT:
- One assistant athletic trainer's name is unrecoverable: the Sports Medicine line reads "Jake Pfeil Jerry Latimer Jeronimo Boche ap steel Brandon Stone Madeleine Scaramuzzo" — "ap steel" is a mangled fourth name. I did NOT create a row for that person rather than invent a name.
- The seminoles.com athletics staff directory itself (school-bio/fsu-contacts.html) could not be retrieved from the Wayback Machine — repeated CDX/API calls returned 429/503 rate limits, and this environment blocks WebFetch against web.archive.org (curl worked, the API did not). Roster page A was retrieved successfully via curl; a January 2014 request redirected to an October 2013 snapshot.
- The live seminoles.com PDF of the 2013 media guide returned an HTML block page, so I used the Internet Archive copies.
- Exact arrival/departure dates for support staff are not documented in any source I found, so midseason_note is populated only for Chris Revell, where the two media guides disagree in a way that is itself evidence.

RELIABILITY WARNING ON 7 ROWS — Wikipedia's "Support Staff" bullet list on the 2013 page is untitled and uncited. Nine of its names (Lynch, Kennedy, Biffani, Helow, Spurlock, Snider, Revell, Warren, Edwards Sr.) are corroborated by the 2013 media guides. Seven are NOT: Jeremiah Wilson, Brian Williams, Jamie Mujeni, Matt McCutchan, Roy Upchurch, Ernest Bradley, Paul Sheffield. I grepped both full media guides for each — zero hits — and targeted web searches returned nothing tying them to FSU in 2013. Several (Upchurch, Jeremiah Wilson) are plausibly from FSU staffs of later seasons, so Wikipedia's list may be anachronistic. I included them because they do have a real source and the task asked for everything documented, but they are flagged individually and should probably be held out of a rings count without further evidence.

SCOPE DECISION: I excluded athletics-department-wide personnel who appear on the media guides' football pages but are not football staff — university president Eric J. Barron, AD Stan Wilcox, Monk Bonasorte, Matt Behnke, Vanessa Fuchs, Dr. Greg Beaumont, and the Communications / Marketing / Facilities / Ticket Office / Business Office blocks (Rob Wilson, Jason Dennard, Drew Longenecker, Nicole Haves, Staci Sutton, Bernie Waxman, Chuck Morris, Laurie Swiger, Brian Donoway, Ben Zierden, Jack Chatham, Michael Espada, Elizabeth Hartsock, Charla Phinney). Team physicians (Dr. Steve Jordan, Dr. Kris Stowers, Dr. William Thompson, Dr. John Katopodis, Dr. Hector Mejia) and specialists (Dr. Darrh Bryant, Dr. Bob Orsillo, Dr. John Van Tassel) are also listed in the guide but serve all 20 FSU sports; I left them out for the same reason. Note that the Sports Medicine trainers I DID include are described in the guide as serving all sports too, except Jake Pfeil, who is explicitly the head football athletic trainer — treat the other five as lower-confidence for a football-rings count.

Total: 57 rows. 10 on-field coaches + head coach role, 4 graduate assistants, 8 quality control, 5 strength/speed, 6 medical, 2 equipment, 3 video, plus operations/personnel/administrative and the 7 flagged Wikipedia-only names.
